description: A list of connections between rooms, comprised of two nodes each

description.description: A textual description of the connection

nodes.description: An array of 2 nodes that each represent one end of a Connection.

items.description: A node that represents one end of a Connection. This is most often a door

area.description: Name of the area containing this node.

roomid.description: ID of the room in which the node exists

nodeid.description: ID of the node within the room in which it exists

position.description: The position of a node within a connection
